title: Evaluative Suffixes: Tone, Affection and Attitude
goal: Recognise and use diminutives, augmentatives and pejoratives for tone and attitude

items: I can use diminutives like *un cafecito* and *ahorita* for warmth, politeness or regional tone.
I can use *-azo* augmentatives for admiration (*un golazo*) and sudden blows (*un portazo*, *un codazo*).
I can recognise and use pejoratives like *un cuartucho* and *un pueblucho* to convey disdain.
